english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for referring to any person.

exampleSentences.english: Anyone can come in and join.
exampleSentences.traditional: 任何人都可以入嚟參加。
exampleSentences.jyutping: jam6 ho4 jan4 dou1 ho2 ji5 jap6 lei4 caam1 gaa1

english.note: Use this when you mean any person in a more explicit or formal-sounding way.

exampleSentences.english: Anybody can apply to join this programme.
exampleSentences.traditional: 任何人都可以申請參加呢個計劃。
exampleSentences.jyutping: jam6 ho4 jan4 dou1 ho2 ji5 san1 cing2 caam1 gaa1 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun phrase for any person, especially when the person is the focus rather than the choice pattern.

exampleSentences.jyutping: jam6 ho4 jan4 dou1 ho2 ji5 caam1 gaa1

english.note: Use this for an indefinite person or people in contexts where English means “whomever” or “any person.”

exampleSentences.english: You can bring anyone whom you want along.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 soeng2 daai3 jam6 ho4 jan4 lei4 dou1 dak1
